dealSummary: Quaise Energy, a geothermal energy company, secured $134 million in the first close of its Series B led by Prelude Ventures.
Legal AI startup Norm AI raised a $120 million Series C led by Khosla Ventures at a $1.2 billion valuation.
EDX Markets, the developer of a digital asset trading platform, secured a $76 million Series C led by SBI Holdings.
Super.com, the developer of a savings and financial services app, raised a $65 million Series D led by TPG at a $1.2 billion valuation.
Bizay, a Portuguese marketplace for customized products, raised a $55 million Series D led by Indico Capital Partners.
Tangos, the developer of an AI platform for financial crime investigations, received a $20 million seed round led by Red Dot Capital Partners.
Hive, a London-based startup building an AI layer for industrial machines, secured a $15 million seed investment led by SuperSeed.
Agave, the developer of a finance platform for the construction industry, raised a $15 million Series A led by Accel.
